TaskDescription: Intraoperative microelectrode recording at a fixed depth in/near the ventral intermediate thalamus (VIM) during DBS surgery for essential tremor, without (acq-off, P-File 'base') or during (acq-on, P-File 'stim') transcutaneous afferent patterned stimulation (TAPS) of the treated hand.

AuthorsProcessing.Description: Authors' MER_preprocess output (P-File field 'raw'): digital low-pass (not documented; measured: power falls 13-20 orders of magnitude from 6-8 kHz to 20-24 kHz), offset removed (zero mean), trimmed to exactly 60 s per trial. Not the unprocessed recording.

BandLimit.Description: Guideline 4000 LP+ (FHC) band limit 20 kHz, digitised at 48 kHz (article)

iEEGReference: Bipolar: each of 3 microelectrodes (Ben-gun, 2 mm apart antero-posterior) against the low-impedance macro contact 1 cm dorsal to its tip (article)
iEEGPlacementScheme: Three parallel Ben-gun microelectrode tracks (anterior/center/posterior) advanced towards the planned VIM target
ElectricalStimulationParameters: TAPS (transcutaneous afferent patterned stimulation, wearable peripheral nerve stimulator) on the treated wrist: frequency 4.1 Hz, amplitude 9.5 mA (P-File stimFreq/stimMiliAmp)
